subject: general
question: Who became U-20 World Wrestling Champion in August, 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is **Antim Panghal.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• **Antim Panghal** was significantly better than her competitors in the** 53 kg weight class.**
 
• She defeated **Amory Andrich of Germany, the U20 European champion,** in the first round before pinning **Ayaka Kimura (Japan).**
 
• She out-technical **Nataliia Klivchutska of Ukraine **to win the semifinal match.
 
• In the crucial match, **Antim defeated Alytn Shagayeva of Kazakhstan.**
 
• After scoring two more points with one more takedown, she secured the deal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Mulayam Yadav **

 
 
• **​Indian** socialist leader **Mulayam Singh Yadav** created the **Samajwadi Party**.
 
• He held the positions of **Minister **of **Defence **and **Chief Minister **of Uttar Pradesh for three terms each during the course of his more than a six-decade political career in India.
 
 
 
• **Sushil Kumar**
 
 
• **Sushil Kumar Solanki is an Indian wrestler.**
 
• He carried the Indian flag during the opening ceremony of the 2012 London Olympics.
 
• Since 1952 **Olympian Khashaba Dadasaheb Jadhav's bronze medal,** his **2008 Olympic medal **was India's first wrestling medal.
